scope: Four original generated design reference sheets; known-source structural review, not blind beauty rating or runtime mesh acceptance.

findings.severity: required reference correction before definitive shape construction
findings.observation: Near-identical S-shaped silhouettes and similar endpoint phase projection for a non-axisymmetric finite helix; stated distinct camera directions cannot be verified. Not a claim that an exact90-degree contradiction was reconstructed metrically.
findings.singleCorrectionTarget: S05 only: keep same winding and same two labeled endpoints A/B; show an actual90-degree side and oblique view, with endpoint phase correspondence. Keep single strip separate from opposite-winding pair assembly.
findings.notRequired: Do not regenerate the plainS04 cylinder or other isolated parts solely for this.

findings.severity: reject placement thumbnail; isolated geometry reference conditionally usable
findings.observation: Thumbnail labels upper collarS17 and lowerS18; fixed BOM defines S17lower at1030/S18upper at1240.
findings.resolution: Retain scoped BOM IDs and original hands/staff placement; do not silently swap IDs. Both collars use one shared shape. No image regeneration required for the isolated annular band.

findings.severity: reject placement thumbnail; isolated geometry reference conditionally usable
findings.observation: Thumbnail puts S15 ball/stem immediately on a grip collar and wrapped shaft; required lantern cage and S14 top-cap placement are absent.
findings.resolution: Use isolatedS15 front/bottom/top/3q as ball-with-stem shape reference only. Register it to S14 socket using the explicit new interface/source and original lantern close-up; never to grip.

conditionalShapes.basis: Single almost straight round shaft, isolated full length and solid round ends. Front/side equivalence is permissible for nearly axisymmetric shape; taper magnitude and shared scale uncalibrated.
Hollow ferrule topology is visible in both end views. Same rolled-rim sleeve shape in front/side/3q; inner seat dimensions unknown.
Separate closed filled disc and thickness edge, no unintended central hole. Its FRONT is a face-on view, not the same object-up/front convention as S02; axis registration remains numerical.
Plain cylindrical grip shell without integral X bands; end interiors visible but dark, images alone do not prove no hidden end cap. Construct deliberate open-ended spec and verify mesh later.
One annular collar form used twice. Front/side image scales are not common/calibrated; widths cannot be used as exact ellipticity or diameter.
Distinct taller stepped hollow neck sleeve; bore/outer lip/waist topology consistent enough for authored profile. Exact axial proportions/hidden seats unknown.

One solid ball and coaxial stem, no second ball/hanging loop/cage. Axisymmetric front/side similarity is acceptable; bottom view shows the stem end. Socket mating dimensions not established by picture.

correctionGenerationLimit.otherThumbnails: Exclude from placement authority; use explicit BOM/interfaces and original full/hands reference.

S05 winding sign/endpoint phase across truly distinct views
